item.title: Olivia Rodrigo Scores Career-Best Opening Week as ‘You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love’ Hits U.K. No. 1
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. We've got some exciting news from across the pond. Olivia Rodrigo is making waves in the UK, and we're here to dive into the details.
[Short music transition]
Host: Rodrigo's latest album, "You Seem Pretty Sad For a Girl So in Love", has soared to the top of the UK's Official Albums Chart, giving her a career-best opening week with 103,000 chart units. This marks her third consecutive number one album, following "Sour" and "Guts". That's quite an achievement, and we're not surprised given her talent.
[Short music transition]
Host: But what does Olivia have to say about this milestone? In a statement to the Official Charts Company, she expressed her gratitude, saying, "Thank you so much for this Number 1 album award! It means so much to me. I wrote so many of these songs in the U.K., so it makes it extra special." She's clearly thrilled, and we can't wait to see what's next for her.
[Short music transition]
Host: Meanwhile, other artists are also making moves on the charts. Michael Jackson's "The Essential" collection holds steady at number two, while Harry Styles sees a bump in his album sales following his 12-night residency at London's Wembley Stadium. And newcomer Sonny Fodera scores his first top 20 placement with "Can We Do It All Again?".
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for this week's music update. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one.
